text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: New Year's break is coming to a close soon. I contact Tosen Jordan's homeroom teacher and learn that she's already back from visiting her family and is in the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I haven't heard from her yet, but there's always the possibility she'll pop in once the break is over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she doesn't come for training, she still has to tell me whether she wants to continue training or if she wants to quit.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's go get our fortunes! I'm gonna keep drawing 'em until I get a good one!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: Isn't that cheating? What about you, Jordan? You want one?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… I think I'll pass…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, Happy New Year. How've you been?
choice_data_list: That's what I wanted to ask you.
That's what I wanted to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, right. Um… Sorry for ghosting you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I've been, like… busy or whatever… But…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh… Right. Hopefully I can…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyways, what did you come to wish for? To meet someone new?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's not a bad idea, actually. Maybe I should pray for someone to come sweep me off my feet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm good. You should make a wish for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'm in great shape. Thanks to… well, because you made me run so much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What I mean is…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're actually really good. You should be aiming bigger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …I wonder if I can really get any better.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're such a go-getter, right? Don't you think that energy's wasted on someone like me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, maybe you should spend it on someone else. You might feel a spark with them!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're actually really good. You should be aiming bigger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You mean something other than really wanting to win? Ahaha, that'd be nice.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I wish I had something…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyways, what about you? I'm flattered, but you're spending too much time daydreaming on my behalf! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're actually really good. You should be aiming bigger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Then, once you're a big shot, I'll be able to brag that I was your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting as long as it takes.
I'll be waiting as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What are you even saying?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, Happy New Year, City! …By the way, have you seen Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I haven't seen her training lately! If she's injured, she's gonna be totes stressy depressy. I wanna go see how she's doing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't think she's injured. She's been coming to class.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? I wonder if something's troubling her… I'll text her lat—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hold up. She hasn't gotten in touch with either of you at all?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nope.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Um, do you mind holding off on any messages?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Jordan is the kind of girl who always lets us know she's okay, even when she's only out with a cold.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But she hasn't texted anyone? That's kinda strange…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: …Wait! You think she's avoiding us?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Suh, fam! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Hey! ☆
